# NASA HRP risk map

<!-- Generated by tools/hrp_map.py from content/cards/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

NASA's Human Research Program lists 17 risks to crew health and performance: https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/risks/ (read 2026-11-15).
This tool covers 3 of them through its measurement cards and does not cover the other 14.

"Covered" means a measurement card watches an Indicator linked to the risk and tells the crew what to do if it is abnormal. It does not mean the tool prevents or diagnoses the risk. Decision support, not diagnosis.

## Risks the tool covers

| HRP risk | Indicator(s) | Card(s) |
|---|---|---|
| Risk of Behavioral Changes and Psychiatric Disorders | `mood` | [`content/cards/mood.json`](../content/cards/mood.json) |
| Risk of Cardiovascular Adaptations | `heart_rate`, `resting_heart_rate`, `systolic_bp` | [`content/cards/heart_rate.json`](../content/cards/heart_rate.json), [`content/cards/systolic_bp.json`](../content/cards/systolic_bp.json) |
| Risk of Inadequate Sleep and Irregular Schedules | `sleep_duration` | [`content/cards/sleep_duration.json`](../content/cards/sleep_duration.json) |

## Risks the tool does not cover

- Risk of Altered Immune System Responses
- Risk of Altered Sensorimotor and Vestibular Function
- Risk of Decompression Sickness
- Risk of Host-Microorganism Interactions
- Risk of Hypoxia
- Risk of Inadequate Food and Nutrition
- Risk of Inadequate Systems Operations Support
- Risk of Inadequate Teamwork
- Risk of Injury and Compromised Performance from Spacewalks
- Risk of Injury from Dynamic Loads
- Risk of Radiation-Induced Cancers
- Risk of Reduced Cardiorespiratory and Musculoskeletal Fitness
- Risk of Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS)
- Risk of Spaceflight-Induced Bone Changes

## Cards that do not map to an HRP risk

These cards are tracked for crew safety but no HRP risk names their Indicator.

| Card | Reason |
|---|---|
| [`content/cards/body_temperature.json`](../content/cards/body_temperature.json) | No HRP risk names body temperature; Hostile/Closed Environments is a NASA hazard, not a risk. |
| [`content/cards/glucose.json`](../content/cards/glucose.json) | No HRP risk names glucose; the closest is Risk of Inadequate Food and Nutrition. |
